description: Finish signing in to Skylight with the 6-digit login code Skylight emailed to the account. Use only after a Skylight tool reported that a login code was emailed; ask the user for the code — never guess one. Pass resend: true (without a code) to have Skylight email a new code.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the Skylight email.

resend.description: Email a new code instead of submitting one.

name: skylight_submit_login_code
